paths.explore.md: #2229 adds the three-way claim disposition (admit / refute / abstain) plus the Unresolved ledger to the /gsd-explore Step-3 research pass, so a surfaced research claim carries its grounding instead of being folded into confident prose unverified. Review round 2 grew it further, all load-bearing rather than elaboration: a resolve-model bash block binding RESEARCHER_MODEL and RESEARCHER_PROFILE (without a bound tier the floor had no operative trigger at all, and its test asserted only that the prose existed), the model= spawn parameter with the #2517 omit-on-inherit rule, an authority-based decision procedure separating refute from abstain (the two arms could previously describe the same event), a defined destination for an untagged finding, and the corrected ledger template. That guidance is written inline in the workflow body and deliberately NOT relocated into an eagerly @-imported reference, which ADR-1610 Decision 4 names as gaming the size proxy (only lazy, Read-at-step extraction counts). Review round 3 grew it again, also load-bearing: the floor keyed on RESEARCHER_PROFILE alone was bypassable by two documented config patterns, because model_overrides[<agent>] and models.research both sit above the profile lookup in resolveModelInternal while --pick profile reports config.model_profile verbatim, so a project on model_profile: balanced with models.research: haiku dispatched a haiku model while the profile still read balanced and the floor never fired. The floor now ORs a resolved-model signal with the profile signal (kept together because codex and qwen have non-Anthropic budget models that a model-only check would miss), the preamble's incorrect claim that --pick profile returns the effective tier is corrected, and the residual is disclosed rather than papered over with a per-runtime model list that would duplicate and drift from bin/shared/model-catalog.json. Review round 4 (rebase onto next) inlines the gsd_run resolver shim into the Step-3 research bash block so gsd_run is defined before the resolve-model probes (#2543 B2 - without it a fresh shell left both probes empty and the tier floor abstained every claim), adds the Step 4-5 rule carrying the disposition into crystallized artifacts (#2543 B3 - an unresolved-ledger claim must never be written as flat prose downstream), and drops the now-redundant eager gsd-run-resolver @-ref (Minor 5 - the shim is inlined where it runs, not eagerly loaded). 11127 -> 25620 bytes (+14493), DEFAULT tier, cap 40960 - 63% of budget.
paths.gsd-phase-researcher.md: #2229 adds the agent-side counterpart to the explore.md workflow change: the phase-researcher agent gains the claim-disposition mode (admit / refute / abstain) it must follow when a /gsd:explore quick-research pass hands it a prompt-level disposition contract, plus the Quick Claim-Disposition Pass section that binds the researcher's return shape (3-5 tagged findings inline, no RESEARCH.md) and the authority-based refute-vs-abstain discriminator and the RESEARCHER_MODEL/RESEARCHER_PROFILE tier floor. This is the executable behavior the workflow guidance delegates to, kept in the agent contract so it is loaded exactly when the agent runs rather than eagerly imported. 42014 -> 43975 bytes (+1961), DEFAULT tier.
